bodyMarkdown:
## Convert Hourly Rate to Annual Pay with Salary Sacrifice Childcare Fees

When you're negotiating a salary or comparing job offers, understanding how your hourly rate translates to annual pay is essential. This guide uses the standard 38-hour week and the 2026-27 tax and super rates. We also explain how salary sacrifice childcare fees can affect your take-home pay.

### The Basic Formula

Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52. We assume a 38-hour week unless your award or agreement specifies otherwise. For example, if you earn $30 per hour, your annual gross is $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280. This is before tax, Medicare, and super.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many employers pay fortnightly. Your fortnightly gross is weekly pay × 2. Using the same $30/hour rate, weekly pay = $30 × 38 = $1,140, so fortnightly = $2,280. This helps you budget and compare with salary offers.

### Minimum Wage and Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44/hour, $1,004.9/week for 38 hours. Casual employees receive 25% loading, making the casual minimum $33.05/hour. Award rates may be higher. Always check your [pay guides](/blog) or [reference tables](/data) for your industry.

### Superannuation on Top

Super guarantee is 12% of your ordinary earnings, paid on top of your hourly rate. It is not deducted from your pay. For $30/hour, annual super = $59,280 × 12% = $7,113.60, up to the $270,830 contribution base. This is an estimate; actual super depends on your ordinary earnings.

### Tax and Medicare

Using 2026-27 resident tax rates: nil to $18,200; 15% to $45,000; 30% to $135,000; 37% to $190,000; 45% above. Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. For $59,280, tax is approximately $5,742 (based on the brackets) plus Medicare $1,185.60. Our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tool can estimate your net pay.

### Salary Sacrifice Childcare Fees

Salary sacrifice childcare fees can reduce your taxable income, lowering your tax and Medicare. For example, if you salary sacrifice $10,000 of childcare fees, your taxable income drops to $49,280, reducing tax and Medicare. This is not included in our basic estimate. Use the [super and packaging](/blog), you type your base hourly rate. The checkbox adds 25% on top. Never type a rate that already includes loading. For $30 base, casual rate = $37.50. Annual gross = $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280, but super is 12% on the base rate, not the casual rate. Check [casual loading](/blog). All employees total earnings average $1,579.2/week (includes part-time). These are averages, not a job median. Your pay may differ. See [average pay](/topics/average-pay) for more.

### Final Thoughts

Understanding your hourly to annual conversion helps you make informed decisions. Whether you are negotiating a salary or considering salary sacrifice childcare fees. Use our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion] tool to see your annual figure. Remember to check your award or agreement for exact conditions.
